source_record: 6 x float32 LE: x east m, y scene m, z south m, scale, yaw rad, class
output_record: 6 x float32 LE: UE_X_cm, UE_Y_cm, UE_Z_cm, yaw_deg, scale, class
note: viewer/assets/forest-instances.f32 is byte-identical to the first 53,999 records of the wide file. Ingest the wide file ONLY; the total number of unique placements is 467601, not 521600.

class_meaning.1: community class 1 - conifer-dominant stand, second variant group
class_meaning.2: community class 2 - deciduous broadleaved association (app.js biases these to broadleaf)

bounds_scene_m.axes: x east, y up (elevation-900), z south

bounds_ue_cm.axes: X north, Y east, Z up

vertical_datum: UE Z = 0 is 900 m MSL, not sea level
